limitations: The unrestricted optimization concerns binary signs only and dimension four. The dimension-five-through-seven optimization concerns quadratic Boolean signs only. Complex phases and higher-dimensional general optimality are not claimed; older array catalogs could contain equivalent results.
scientific_integrity: The binary four-cube optimum is an exhaustive 2048-case gauge-reduced integer proof. The quadratic cases are exhaustive all-graph enumerations through seven vertices supported by an algebraic Fourier-to-graph identity and standalone C++17 checker. Literature comparisons distinguish prior path constructions from optimality.
title: Sharp binary fourth moments on the four-cube and quadratic path rigidity through seven variables
